subject: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <amercer@kindredlabs.ai>, contracts@kindredlabs.ai
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion

Alex — thanks again for the usage export this morning. We reviewed Kindred's trailing-90-day utilization and queue metrics and put together a short, practical proposal for the renewal that aligns with the real traffic pattern you shared. High level summary: add a small, phased dedicated tranche now (18 A100 equiv), then convert another 12 from burst to reserved over Q4 if peak utilization remains elevated; include a 20% safety buffer for predictable latency during training spikes.

Key datapoints from your export:
- 90-day 95th-percentile concurrent GPU demand: ~110 A100-equivalent
- Current committed reserve: 100 A100-equivalent
- Observed queueing (latency spikes >300ms for inference frontends) on 12 peak days

Proposed path: 
1) Immediate add: +18 A100-equivalent reserved (can be provisioned as 6 x 3-GPU nodes or 3 x 6-GPU nodes depending on your preference). This reduces observed 95th pct gap and gives headroom for scheduled experiments.
2) Conditional top-up: +12 A100-equivalent (Q4 convert burst credits -> reserved) if average weekly queue duration >2s for 3 consecutive weeks.
3) Safety buffer: keep 20% headroom relative to observed 95th pct for the first 90 days and re-evaluate with usage reports and our observability dashboards.

Pricing: draft numbers are in the attached kindred_commit_matrix_v2.xlsx. We can offer a one-time onboarding credit (covers first-week burst) in exchange for a 12-month reserved commitment on the new tranche.

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: confirm whether procurement needs the add on a single SOW or two line-items (immediate tranche + conditional top-up).
- Kimberly / Ben: quick review of SLA/price terms and whether legal needs expanded rollback language for the conditional top-up.

I can hop on a 30-min call Monday if helpful.

—David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachment: kindred_commit_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: Alex Mercer <amercer@kindredlabs.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@kindredlabs.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion

Thanks David — this is helpful and close to what we expected. A couple of clarifying questions before procurement gets involved: 

1) Can you convert the +18 proposal to an equivalent in vCPU-backed nodes for our on-prem replication tests? We run a mixed workload and want to keep parity with our internal staging.
2) How will the conditional top-up be triggered on your side? Can we get an automated alert (email + console flag) when the weekly queue duration threshold is met?

Procurement note: we prefer a single SOW with two line-items (immediate + contingent) so internal approvals don't have to re-open the entire agreement.

Happy to take a call Wednesday afternoon.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of ML Ops, Kindred Labs
amercer@kindredlabs.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion

David / team — quick notes from a commercial and ops perspective: 
- Single SOW with two line-items is fine; we'll include the conditional top-up as an annex (clear trigger metric + 30-day notice for conversion).
- For the vCPU-backed equivalence Alex asked for: we'll provide a conversion table (A100-eq -> Trent-XL nodes) in the SOW attachment. Ops needs to confirm whether the immediate tranche should be spread across AZs for redundancy.
- On the alerting side: we can create a console-based watch that flips a flag and emails both the Kindred contacts and our renewals alias. I'll draft the alert text.

Ben — check the suggested 20% buffer. Do we want to make that a sliding buffer (20% first 90 days, 15% thereafter) to avoid long-term overcommit?

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion

Agree with Kimberly. My operational take: 20% buffer is sensible up-front because Kindred's scheduled weekly batch retraining (nightly windows) creates short high-concurrency bursts. Proposal: make the buffer automatic for the first 90 days, then run a usage eval and offer an option to drop to 10–15% or shift to burst credits. For the immediate tranche: suggest we provision the +18 as a canary split: 12 reserved in primary pool +6 in a dedicated canary pool with tighter autoscale rules. That lets us validate tail latency and reclaim canary capacity quickly if utilization is less than expected.

I'll also update SOW text to include rollback terms and a 14-day payment net for the conditional tranche activation.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-dedicated-addendum-KL.pdf

From: Alex Mercer <amercer@kindredlabs.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 23:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Kindred Labs renewal: proposed GPU add + safety buffer discussion

Thanks all — that addresses our concerns. A few small asks before we finalize SOW: 
- Include the vCPU equivalence table in the SOW (requested by our infra team).
- Canary approach sounds great; please call out the monitoring windows and rollback path explicitly (we want documented SLAs for the canary pool).
- For billing: Kindred will approve the immediate tranche on a 12-month term and we accept the conditional-topup clause with the 14-day net if the trigger runs.

Please send a redlined SOW and we can get procurement to sign next week.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of ML Ops, Kindred Labs
amercer@kindredlabs.ai
